summary: Israeli forces killed Hamas Northern Gaza Brigade commander Izz al-Din al-Bik, who held Israeli hostages and participated in the October 7 attacks. The IDF also eliminated two October 7 infiltrators, including a Hamas squad commander involved in kidnapping six hostages from Kibbutz Be'eri. Meanwhile, the Israeli Air Force struck over 500 targets in Lebanon and Gaza over the past month, while Yemen's government conducted 13 airstrikes on Houthi positions in Taiz.

IDF killed two October 7 infiltrators: Muhammad Abu Alshaer (Hamas) involved in kidnapping six from Be'eri, and Moatsab Balbisi (Islamic Jihad) in Jabalia. (Source: @New_security8200/204067)
IAF struck over 500 targets in past month: 370+ Hezbollah targets in south Lebanon, 140+ Hamas targets in Gaza including three brigade commanders. (Source: @pkpoi/144141)
Yemen's government forces conducted 13 precision airstrikes on Houthi targets in Taiz governorate, destroying a tank and military vehicles. (Source: @shin_persian/10666)
Saudi-led coalition intercepted a Houthi-fired ballistic missile targeting Khamis Mushait. (Source: @N12chat/228063)
Netanyahu stated the FlyDubai stabbing pilot underwent Islamist radicalization and warned Iran may target Israeli interests during election period. (Source: @New_security8200/204066)
